statement: The node that started a dispute finalizes it once the chain's clock has passed the dispute's window, with no counter in between (a start the peer countered is not finalized by the starter). The Entity keeps what it asked the chain to start with (`starting`: the `dispute_start` fields), the end of the window once the chain says one is open (`j_dispute` of the node's own side carries the chain's `disputeTimeout`, the second the window ends; the first one told for the epoch is kept, one of another epoch, of another nonce than the start's, or of the peer's is not this record's; a second dispute ask while the record stands is refused (`dispute_pending`), since the chain holds the dispute it opened first), and whether the window is over. The Host's J loop tells it the window is over (`j_window_over`) when the last block of a delivery, which is final at the configured depth (D9), has a second at or past the end: the block's own timestamp, never the Host's clock, and the windows are read off the Entity's own chain facts, which the WAL rebuilds, so a restart forgets none. Once over, every frame of the Entity asks (`dispute_finalize`) with the start's nonce, author and proof body and whether the node is the Account's Left, and restates it until the chain says the dispute is over (`j_dispute_over`) or the epoch moves on; the Host de-duplicates, and the chain skips a finalize of a dispute that is already over. The Host's op is the chain's finalization of that dispute from the same proof: initial and final nonce equal, the body's own hash, empty arguments, no signature, not cooperative. A window over before the chain gave one, or with no start of the node's own, asks nothing. The WAL row names every field of the ask: a replay with another peer, nonce, author, side or body diverges. Not here: the finalize of a dispute the node answered with a counter (R-DISPUTE-WATCH), and a start or finalize the chain refuses. A start the peer countered is not finalized with the opening proof: the node that started it hears the counter (`j_countered`) and stops asking.
source: coordinator 10-02 (S8 forced dispute through the node, window and finalize); contracts-decisions.md Dispute window and finalize through the node

layers.arrival: n/a: the Arrival page models the Account's frames; the window and the finalize are Entity, Host and J-loop rules
layers.quint: n/a: the Quint model has the chain's dispute cells; when the node asks to finalize is not one of them
layers.contract: n/a: the chain finalizes when block.timestamp is at or past disputeTimeout and the evidence is the state that settles; the e2e dispute step finalizes through the node after the clock passes the window
layers.rig: n/a: an off-chain Entity, Host and J-loop rule

killers.name: R-DISPUTE-FINALIZE the node keeps what it started with, and asks nothing more until the window is over
R-DISPUTE-FINALIZE the window is the one the chain gave the node's own dispute of this epoch
R-DISPUTE-FINALIZE a window over before the chain gave one, or with no start, asks nothing
R-DISPUTE-FINALIZE once the window is over the node asks to finalize with the state it started from
R-DISPUTE-FINALIZE every frame restates the finalize until the chain says the dispute is over
R-DISPUTE-FINALIZE the epoch moving on ends the dispute too: nothing is finalized for the next one
R-DISPUTE-FINALIZE a Host that restarts keeps the window and is asked to finalize again
R-DISPUTE-FINALIZE the one who is the Account's Right says so in the ask
R-DISPUTE-FINALIZE a window the last block has passed is told after the logs, and not before
R-DISPUTE-FINALIZE a window the last block has passed is told to the Entity after the events
R-DISPUTE-FINALIZE a window of another dispute nonce than the one the node started is not taken
R-DISPUTE-FINALIZE a second dispute ask while one stands is refused, and the finalize keeps the first
a second dispute ask while the first stands is refused: the chain holds the first start's nonce
R-DISPUTE-FINALIZE the windows an Entity waits on are the node's own the chain gave an end, until told
R-DISPUTE-FINALIZE a window the delivery itself opened for the node's own start is told after it
the ask names the start's nonce, author and body, and whether the node is the Account's Left
the Host's op is the chain's finalization of that dispute, with its own hash of the body
R-DURABLE a WAL whose dispute finalize names another peer, nonce, author, side or body does not replay
